steps.content: After walking for what feels like an eternity, the unknown monsters pestering you along the way gradually vanish. You begin seeing some fine ropes tied to the trees in the woods.
The ropes are wrapped with old cloth strips and attached to rusty bells. In the windless darkness, only your passing makes them ring softly, as if signaling a boundary or a warning.
The feeble light that draws you here floats just beyond a few ropes, almost within reach.

In the darkness, the sparks reveal a small clearing, where a few dry branches on the ground form a not-so-round magic circle less than a meter wide. The lines are crooked, the pattern simple, leaving its specific meaning unclear.
You break off a twig and throw it into the center of the circle. Nothing happens. You erase part of the circle with your hand. Everything remains the same.
It seems there's no mysterious power to this thing. Someone was probably just doodling here with a stick dipped in water.

The dead branches, the hanging bells, the circle, and the faint sparks that illuminate the darkness... This resembles some kind of mysterious ritual to keep the monsters away. It's not the FAC's style, and you can't imagine any scholars from the expedition coming up with this.
The drawing hasn't dried yet, with blurry footprints within and around it. The person who drew the circle was here not long ago but seems to have left in a hurry.
...Are they really gone? Your senses in the dream feel particularly sharp, detecting some kind of presence from the darkness behind you.
You turn toward the unlit spot, following your intuition into the darkness, your hand tightly gripping the shackles.
Sure enough, having walked less than two meters, you hear something.
If this crude trap was indeed made for you, its maker probably wouldn't come out to meet you until you fell into it. Anyway, it's just a dream...
You walk straight into the center of the circle, stretching out your body exaggeratedly. And then, just as you wish...
Ia! Cthugha!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What?

A shrill cry pierces the darkness. Sparks burst out of the circle on the ground while the surrounding bells ring loudly, besieging you. Startled, you turn to the ringing bells and immediately realize they're a decoy.
Behind you, a massive club as tall as a person suddenly breaks through the darkness and lands right on your head.
Die, monster!
Aaahhh—!!
You dodged the attack, and the figure stumbles and topples past you.
The attacker seems unable to wield the heavy club, losing balance and falling to the ground with a cry.
No, no, no! Stay away from me!

Failing to get up, the person desperately scrambles backward. The courageous determination just now has completely evaporated, and she now tries to hide from your gaze in the darkness, nearly sobbing.
But the floating flames quietly gather around her, dispelling the shadows and revealing a petite figure.

It's a short and frail girl with a pale tear-streaked face. She wears a strange robe and no shoes, her legs covered in mud and wounds. The long torch she holds is probably the weapon she used to attack you.
She trembles violently, cornered against the roots of a tree, curling up into a ball.

steps.speaker: Girl in Strange Clothes
steps.content: No... Get away, monster... If you dare come a step closer, I-I'll...
Monster? Is she talking about you?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm not a monster. I'm a human, just like you. Take a good look at me with the light, okay?
Yet she gasps in fear and shrinks even smaller.

steps.speaker: Girl in Strange Clothes
steps.content: You're covered in <color=#fb9259>red spikes</color>... You're a monster! Back off! Don't talk to me. I won't fall for your trap!

steps.speaker: Girl in Strange Clothes
steps.content: I can see. Even if you're cloaked in human skin and speak the human language, I can tell. The holy fire will guide me. I'm not... I'm not blind!
At this, you instinctively search for her eyes...

Her eyes are too pale and dim. Although her gaze occasionally falls on you, it just seems unfocused. She's waving the torch frantically to keep you away, seemingly without any idea where you really are, as if she can't see you.
Is she blind? Or visually impaired? It appears she can only roughly discern your location by sound.

steps.speaker: Girl in Strange Clothes
steps.content: The holy fire will purify you, and the Pyromater will punish you, I... I'm not afraid of you! I have people coming to help me!

steps.speaker: Girl in Strange Clothes
steps.content: They're all elite scientists who know how best to deal with you! They'll be here soon. I'm their important guide. If anything happens to me, you're done for! We clear?!

steps.speaker: Girl in Strange Clothes
steps.content: So go away and grovel back to your own god. Stop bothering me! Back off!
You raise your hand to catch the torch swung at you, effortlessly removing it from her hands. Shocked, the girl tries to get up but collapses heavily to the ground.

steps.speaker: Girl in Strange Clothes
steps.content: No, no... I don't want to die here...

steps.speaker: Girl in Strange Clothes
steps.content: Captain! Helen! Where are you? Help me!
You stop approaching but instead step back a little and begin softly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I won't come any closer without your permission. I just want to talk to you.

steps.speaker: Girl in Strange Clothes
steps.content: Go away!
You hold back the shackles and squat down to meet her eyes.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Are the red spikes still there?

steps.content: Still wary, she doesn't answer, but there's a hint of consideration in her expression, as if she's trying hard to tell.

steps.speaker: Girl in Strange Clothes
steps.content: ...Where did you hide those spikes of light? Are you... a shapeshifter?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is how I've always looked. Those spikes are just a weapon I use for self-defense. Just like you need the torch, I need something to protect myself too.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But we're not enemies. I'm not going to hurt you, so I've put it away.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you promise not to hit me with the torch again, I'll give you back your weapon so you can feel safe, okay?
You say as you squat down and offer her the torch. The girl doesn't take it, her pale eyes warily staring in your direction.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Just now, you said you have companions?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Where are they? Did you get separated from them?

steps.speaker: Girl in Strange Clothes
steps.content: ...Like I'll tell you.

steps.speaker: Option
options: I'm also looking for some friends. A team of scholars.

steps.content: She sits up abruptly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It consists of a calm, knowledgeable girl who loves stargazing, a girl who loves to laugh and knows a lot about biology, and a mechanic who doesn't talk much but is in fact very kind...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They're all very nice people and brilliant scientists. They should be around here too.

steps.speaker: Girl in Strange Clothes
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Dreya, Marguerite, and... Vanilla...</color>

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Just like you, I'm looking for them too. If you're a guide, can you show me the way?
She relaxes her tense body, "looking" in your direction.

steps.speaker: Girl in Strange Clothes
steps.content: ...Are you also part of the <color=#fb9259>expedition</color>?

steps.speaker: Girl in Strange Clothes
steps.content: But I've never heard your voice...
You hesitate. As you deliberate for an answer, she props herself up slightly, fumbling in front of her as if looking for something to support herself. You offer her the torch.
But the girl doesn't take it. Her bony hand reaches toward you, trembling as it lands on your cheek. At the moment of contact, you freeze.
Unlike others in the dream who pass right through you, her fingertips rise and fall repeatedly, every touch incredibly gentle and clear in the silence.

Cheekbones, eyelids, eyebrows, the tip of your nose, the corners of your mouth... She carefully traces the contours of your face with her hands. The gaze on you remains hollow, yet you see emotions slowly exuding from her eyes.

steps.speaker: Girl in Strange Clothes
steps.content: I've never heard your voice, but somehow... I recognize you. You feel familiar... just like everyone else...

steps.speaker: Girl in Strange Clothes
steps.content: ...How strange. How could I mistake you for a monster? It never happened with anyone else on the team before...

steps.speaker: Girl in Strange Clothes
steps.content: I'm so sorry. I can't see very well, and being here all alone for far too long really made me paranoid... I hope I didn't hurt you.
The flames illuminate her face. She smiles at you, but tears are streaming down her cheeks uncontrollably.

steps.speaker: Girl in Strange Clothes
steps.content: Haha, don't worry. I'm just too happy, so happy. I...

steps.speaker: Girl in Strange Clothes
steps.content: ...Ever since splitting up with you guys, I've been terrified.

steps.speaker: Girl in Strange Clothes
steps.content: It's so dark here and monsters are everywhere. I'm so scared. In my dreams, bad things often happen to you guys, so you can never return... But thankfully, you...

steps.speaker: Girl in Strange Clothes
steps.content: You're still alive... How wonderful...
Her voice dwindles and her hands rest on your chest feebly to support herself as she bows her head and sobs.
Before you even realize it, you've raised your arms around her, as if ready to embrace her tightly, as if you're also overwhelmed by a certain surging emotion...
You pause and withdraw your arms, only putting your hands on her shoulders.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're fine now. I've found you, and I'll protect you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're a member of the expedition too, right? I'm often out on missions. I don't think we've met before. What's your name?
You hold her up by her trembling shoulders and ask gently.
Your words have soothed her. Slowly, the girl stops sobbing and squeezes out a funny smile.

steps.speaker: Girl in Strange Clothes
steps.content: I'm Hestia. What about you?

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: I must remember your name and your face, so I won't make the same mistake again.
She wipes her tears and smiles. Reaching out with both hands, this time she presses her warm palms on your face boldly, cupping your cheeks and tracing your ears with her fingers.
And then as Hestia touches your <color=#fb9259>earring</color>, she freezes for a moment.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: This earring...

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: It's you?!
Her smile vanishes, her face flushes, and her eyes widen. She shoves you with both hands, surprisingly pushing you down to the ground.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: You little punk, are you playing me for a fool?!
The next instant, the long torch is swung up again and this time lands square on your forehead. With a buzz in your head, everything goes black...
[Flash]
Your eyes snap open. Before you, Schorl is performing a scan on you, pulling you back to reality.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: You just fell into a dream of the Illusory Moon again.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I made primary contact with some people.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If I can go back, I should be able to get useful information.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Your speculation is correct. Paradeisos has yet to find a way to solve this problem. When your mind is weak, you might get captured again.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: You may continue <color=#fb9259>exploring</color>, but please don't be ensnared by the Illusory Moon again.
You look at your hands. Your forehead doesn't hurt, but the touch and the warmth you felt when patting her back still linger in your palms.
In that interwoven dream, people existing in reality couldn't touch you. If the girl could touch you, it can only mean...
That was just a <color=#fb9259>trap</color> to lure you in.
You clench your fists and teeth.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm aware of the situation. Next time... I won't fall for that again.
